demo.post: r/androidapps: My focus timer pauses any time I leave it. I want it to count reading a PDF as work but still stop when I open a feed. Is an allow-list or a one-off exception less annoying? Please explain trade-offs; no promotion.
candidates: contenteditable multiline draft

I have tried a few timers and I do like the idea of pausing when I get distracted, but I also switch between a bunch of things for work, and sometimes I am reading a document and sometimes I am just avoiding a hard task, so I am not sure how the timer would know. I guess a list might help, but then I would probably put too many things on it, and I would still need to think about whether I was actually working.
I would start with an allow-list. It seems easier than choosing an exception every time I leave the app.

Let the user add just their PDF reader and editor to a work-app list, and pause on anything else. Show the list in settings so they can remove apps they added too casually. A one-off exception would fit rare tasks, but I would keep that optional.
